guidance.summary: Wires and Cables EBITDA margin expected between 11% and 13% long-term
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany
guidance.quote: In line with our Project Spring roadmap, we remain confident of sustaining medium - to long -term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%.

guidance.summary: Targeting 1.5x to 2x industry revenue growth rate for FMEG segment
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany
guidance.quote: Our objective continues to be growing at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability.

guidance.summary: Expecting FMEG EBITDA margin to be between 8% and 10% long-term
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany
guidance.quote: So over the longer term, I believe we would end up in that kind of a range of 8% to 10% of the EBITDA margin.

guidance.summary: Targeting Wires and Cables volume growth of 1.5x market growth rate
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany
guidance.quote: What we have called out already, as an anchor to look into the volume growth, is that whatever the market grows, we will do 1.5x of that in cable and wires. Right?

guidance.summary: EPC order book profile expected close to INR 9,000 to 10,000 crores
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany
guidance.quote: Roughly the order book, I would say it is close to around INR9,000 crores, INR10,000 crores.
